title: The Moon
summary: Earth's only natural satellite. Its pull drives our ocean tides, and its far side always faces away from us.

title: Mars
summary: A cold, dusty desert world with the tallest volcano in the solar system and two tiny moons.

title: The Sun
summary: The star at the center of our solar system, providing light and heat to sustain life on Earth.

title: Saturn
summary: Famous for its stunning rings, Saturn is a gas giant with dozens of moons and a captivating atmosphere.

title: Jupiter
summary: The largest planet in our solar system, Jupiter is a gas giant with a powerful magnetic field and dozens of moons.

title: Andromeda Galaxy
summary: The nearest spiral galaxy to the Milky Way, Andromeda is on a collision course with our galaxy, expected to merge in about 4.5 billion years.
